issue.title: Allow a third authored bullet level for details inside captured drawer notes
issue.description: Proposed by bob-cli-fc.1 note 1, bob-cli-fc.3 note 2, and bob-cli-fc.4 note 2. AuthoredDepth remains First/Nested, so a drawer bullet consumes the first level and its notes consume the second: details beneath those notes cannot be authored. Design and implement a third level across execution/editor parsing, completion, rendering, and client fixtures, preserving existing two-level semantics and atomic writes. Duplicate searches across all statuses and the recent-task sweep found none; active epics do not own this explicit non-goal.

task_type_fields.proposal: Support a third authored bullet level so notes inside drawer bullets can carry detail bullets.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The approved capture_drawer_bullets epic explicitly keeps the two-level authored grammar; deeper nesting is a separate grammar-wide design change.

issue.creation_reason: The bob-cli-fc plan explicitly defers deeper nesting, and phases fc.1, fc.3, and fc.4 requested this follow-up.
